subject.title: Feature: Project trees + threaded entry points in Control UI

question: Should session `category` serve as the initial durable Project identity, and should selected-message triage copy context into a new branch rather than remove or rewrite history?
rationale: Current main supplies the UI grouping and full-session branch foundation, but repository behavior cannot determine the intended persistent project model or safe transcript semantics for partial-message triage.

options.title: Extend existing sessions
options.body: Use session categories as project groups and add additive message-copy branching plus explicit composer route targets.

options.title: Adopt first-class Projects
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/13676 canonical and define a separate Project entity before adding triage or routing.

options.title: Stop at current primitives
options.body: Treat groups, forks, and split panes as sufficient and decline message-level triage and fanout complexity.

recommendation.title: Extend existing sessions
recommendation.body: Use session categories as project groups and add additive message-copy branching plus explicit composer route targets.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the most recent merged session-management and grouping history and already reviewed this exact product boundary.
